amendments.body: Unify the alkalinity stoichiometry source across runtime defaults and preset/scenario loading. `ProcessParams::default()` now uses `NITRIFICATION_ALK_MEQ_PER_MG_N` at `/home/master/p/tank-simulation/.claude/worktrees/tanksim-6e5.4.7/crates/tank_core/src/types/process.rs:338`, but the preset-side defaults still hard-code `0.1428` at `/home/master/p/tank-simulation/.claude/worktrees/tanksim-6e5.4.7/crates/tank_data/src/presets.rs:1018` and the shipped process preset still serializes `0.1428` at `/home/master/p/tank-simulation/.claude/worktrees/tanksim-6e5.4.7/crates/tank_data/data/process/default.toml:54`. Because scenarios copy the preset value verbatim at `/home/master/p/tank-simulation/.claude/worktrees/tanksim-6e5.4.7/crates/tank_scenarios/src/lib.rs:391-392`, the same tank now consumes different alkalinity depending on whether it was built via `TankState::new()` or via the shipped preset path.
amendments.rationale: This patch introduces an exact named constant, but only one construction path uses it. The current split makes scientific behavior and test results depend on how the engine was initialized.

amendments.body: Fix the new nitrogen-cycle trace output so the nitrogen quantity matches the alkalinity quantity it is emitted next to. The trace now emits `nitrogen_cycle.total_n_nitrified_mg` and `nitrogen_cycle.alk_consumed_meq` together at `/home/master/p/tank-simulation/.claude/worktrees/tanksim-6e5.4.7/crates/tank_core/src/engine.rs:229-238`, but `total_mg_n_nitrified` is computed as `nob_step + comammox_step` at `/home/master/p/tank-simulation/.claude/worktrees/tanksim-6e5.4.7/crates/tank_core/src/systems/nitrogen_cycle.rs:343-346` while alkalinity consumption is computed from `aob_alk_cost + comammox_alk_cost` at `/home/master/p/tank-simulation/.claude/worktrees/tanksim-6e5.4.7/crates/tank_core/src/systems/nitrogen_cycle.rs:366-384`. In any tick where AOB produces nitrite faster than NOB clears it, the trace can report positive alkalinity consumption alongside zero or underreported `total_n_nitrified_mg`, which makes the new diagnostics scientifically misleading.
amendments.rationale: The patch’s new user-visible tracing is supposed to explain alkalinity loss. Right now it can surface impossible-looking stoichiometry because the two reported quantities are based on different nitrogen pathways.

payload.summary: Reviewed the alkalinity-accounting/tracing changes in the worktree and ran targeted tests (`cargo test -p tank_core --test nitrification_alkalinity`, `water_change_mass_balance`, `tracing`, and `budget_tracking`), which passed. I found two correctness issues: the new named stoichiometric constant is not wired through the preset/scenario path, and the newly emitted nitrogen-cycle trace counter does not measure the same nitrogen flow as the alkalinity counter it is paired with.
